_comment: Slayer collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed slayer-breathing` (lines may be shared with other collections since #24), then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_slayer.py.

readme.title: Slayer
readme.summary: Pokemon as demon slayers in patterned haori with a breathing style (inspired by the Demon Slayer anime; traditional Japanese patterns).
looks: each line wears one haori over a dark uniform with a white belt: green-and-black checks with fire at the hem (Kubfu, Spinda, Fidough); blue wave scales with flowing water (Buizel, Bruxish, Quaxly); white with flames licking up from the hem (Seedot, Maractus, Spearow); yellow with white triangle scales and crackling lightning (Dreepy, Staryu, Poochyena); a butterfly-wing haori with glowing spots (Lileep, Bellsprout, Natu); mist-white to cyan with drifting mist (Trubbish, Terapagos, Smoliv)
each breathing style glows in the dark: water rolls, flames flicker, lightning strikes, mist drifts; the eyes keep their own colours
shiny: the haori's colours turned round the colour wheel
